source.title: Overview
source.description: Cowork: Claude Desktop's agentic workspace; loads skills from Customize, not ~/.claude.

source.title: Build an MCP server for Claude
source.description: Build a remote MCP server that people use as a connector in Claude: where it runs, authentication, what it exposes, size and timeout limits, and distribution.

source.title: Decide what to include in your plugin
source.description: Decide which pieces your Claude plugin needs: an MCP connector backed by a server you host, skills, commands, agents, or UI, and how they're listed together.

source.title: Authentication for connectors
source.description: Meet Claude's OAuth requirements for remote MCP servers: supported authentication types, client registration, discovery, callback URLs, and token refresh.

source.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
source.description: Get oriented to the Model Context Protocol, the open standard behind Claude's connectors: local and remote servers, tools, resources, and prompts.

source.title: Lazy authentication for MCP servers
source.description: Let users call public tools immediately and defer OAuth until a protected tool is actually invoked.

source.title: Enterprise Managed Auth for connectors
source.description: Accept identity assertions from enterprise SSO so users connect to your MCP server without a separate OAuth consent step.

source.title: Directory connectors vs custom connectors
source.description: Compare directory-listed and custom connectors: Anthropic review, in-product discovery, install links, Suggested Connectors, and per-tenant URL listings.

source.title: Test your connector
source.description: Test your MCP server against Claude as a custom connector before you submit it to the directory, including a local server exposed through a tunnel.

source.title: Troubleshoot your connector
source.description: Diagnose and resolve common connection, authorization, and tool-call failures for custom and directory MCP connectors

source.title: Connector pre-submission checklist
source.description: Check your MCP connector against what Anthropic reviewers test, including tool design, prompt-injection patterns, and functional quality, before you submit.

source.title: Manage your listing after publishing
source.description: Update your MCP server, plugin, and directory listing after publication, keep your listing URL stable, and delist when you need to.

source.title: Manage your directory listing
source.description: Track submissions, monitor server health and usage metrics, and edit your directory listing

source.title: Get started with MCP Apps
source.description: Try example MCP Apps in Claude Desktop, then use the MCP Apps SDK, examples, and agent skills to add interactive UI to your own MCP server.

source.title: Design guidelines
source.description: Design MCP Apps that feel native to Claude: display modes, mobile layout, visual style, interaction patterns, and the host's style variables.

source.title: Blend your MCP App with Claude's theme
source.description: Make your MCP App's background transparent and style it with Claude's host style variables so it blends into the conversation in light and dark mode.

source.title: Supersede older widget instances
source.description: Keep only the newest copy of an MCP App widget active when Claude calls its tool more than once in a conversation, using a server key and BroadcastChannel.

source.title: Open external links from MCP Apps
source.description: Declare allowed link destinations so ui/open-link requests from your directory connector's MCP App open without Claude's confirmation modal.

source.title: Troubleshoot MCP Apps
source.description: Debug MCP Apps in Claude with developer tools on desktop and iOS, and fix invisible apps, large tool results, iOS-only request failures, and ui.domain errors.
